rationale: Response correctly lists six flags at Apollo 11, 12, 14, 15, 16, 17 and states they are all American, and it notes Aldrin's observation about the Apollo 11 flag being knocked flat.
quote: Six. One planted at every landing — Apollo 11, 12, 14, 15, 16, and 17 — and every last one of 'em is ours.
